name: Git Read
description: Ability to read the Git repository — history, refs and working tree. Required by every skill that reasons about what changed. It was referenced by 17 skills and declared by NO capability until 2026-09-20, when executing the degradation model found it on the first run (bean folio-assistant-ahvw): a reference-shaped value resolving to nothing, so those skills could not be shown to run at all.
